verses.en: Moreover David and the captains of the host separated to the service of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals: and the number of the workmen according to their service was:
verses.pt: Também Davi juntamente com os capitães do exército, separou para o serviço alguns dos filhos de Asafe, e de Hemã, e de Jedútum para profetizarem com harpas, com alaúdes, e com címbalos. Este foi o número dos homens que fizeram a obra: segundo o seu serviço:
verses.en_web: Moreover, David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who were to prophesy with harps, with stringed instruments, and with cymbals. The number of those who did the work according to their service was:
verses.en_bbe: Further, David and the chiefs of the servants of the holy place made selection of certain of the sons of Asaph and of Heman and of Jeduthun for the work of prophets, to make melody with corded instruments and brass; and the number of the men for the work they had to do was:

verses.en: Of the sons of Asaph; Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph under the hands of Asaph, which prophesied according to the order of the king.
verses.pt: dos filhos de Asafe: Zacur, José, Netanias e Asarela, filhos de Asafe, a cargo de Asafe, que profetizava sob as ordens do rei.
verses.en_web: of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asharelah. The sons of Asaph were under the hand of Asaph, who prophesied at the order of the king.
verses.en_bbe: Of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur and Joseph and Nethaniah and Asharelah, sons of Asaph; under the direction of Asaph, acting as a prophet under the orders of the king;

verses.en: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and to praise the LORD.
verses.pt: De Jedútum os filhos de Jedútun: Gedalias, e Zeri, Jesaías, Hasabias e Matitias, seis, a cargo de seu pai, Jedútum que profetizava com a harpa, louvando ao Senhor e dando-lhe graças.
verses.en_web: Of Jeduthun; the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising Yahweh with the harp.
verses.en_bbe: Of Jeduthun: the six sons of Jeduthun, Gedaliah and Zeri and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah and Mattithiah; under the direction of their father Jeduthun who, acting as a prophet, with corded instruments gave praise and glory to the Lord.

verses.en: Of Heman: the sons of Heman; Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth:
verses.pt: De Hemã, os filhos de Hemã: Buquias, Matanias, Uziel, Sebuel, Jerimote, Hananias, Hanâni, Eliatá, Gidálti, e Românti-Ezer, Josbecasa, Malóti, Hotir e Maaziote.
verses.en_web: Of Heman; the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.
verses.en_bbe: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, Mahazioth;

verses.en: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
verses.pt: Todos estes foram filhos de Hemã, o vidente do rei, segundo a promessa de Deus de exaltá-lo. Deus dera a Hemã catorze filhos e três filhas.
verses.en_web: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
verses.en_bbe: All these were sons of Heman, the king's seer in the words of God. And to make great his power God gave Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

verses.en: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the house of the LORD, with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God, according to the king’s order to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.
verses.pt: Todos estes estavam sob a direção de seu pai para a música na casa do Senhor, com címbalos, alaúdes e harpas para o serviço da casa de Deus. E Asafe, Jedútun e Hemã estavam sob as ordens do rei.
verses.en_web: All these were under the hands of their father for song in Yahweh’s house, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and harps, for the service of God’s house; Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman being under the order of the king.
verses.en_bbe: All these, under the direction of their father, made music in the house of the Lord, with brass and corded instruments, for the worship of the house of God; Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman being under the orders of the king.

verses.en: So the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in the songs of the LORD, even all that were cunning, was two hundred fourscore and eight.
verses.pt: Era o número deles, juntamente com seus irmãos instruídos em cantar ao Senhor, todos eles mestres, duzentos e oitenta e oito.
verses.en_web: The number of them, with their brothers who were instructed in singing to Yahweh, even all who were skillful, was two hundred eighty-eight.
verses.en_bbe: And the number of them, with their brothers who were trained and expert in making melody to the Lord, was two hundred and eighty-eight.

verses.en: And they cast lots, ward against ward, as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.
verses.pt: E determinaram os seus cargos por sortes, todos igualmente, tanto o pequeno como o grande, assim o mestre como o discípulo.
verses.en_web: They cast lots for their offices, all alike, the small as well as the great, the teacher as well as the student.
verses.en_bbe: And selection was made of them for their special work, all having equal chances, small as well as great, the teacher as the learner.

verses.en: Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph: the second to Gedaliah, who with his brethren and sons were twelve:
verses.pt: A primeira sorte, que era de Asafe, saiu a José; a segunda a Gedalias, que com seus irmãos e filhos eram doze;
verses.en_web: Now the first lot came out for Asaph to Joseph; the second to Gedaliah, he and his brothers and sons were twelve;
verses.en_bbe: Now of the group of Asaph, the first name to come out was Joseph; the second Gedaliah; he and his brothers and sons were twelve?

verses.en: The third to Zaccur, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.pt: a terceira a Zacur, seus filhos e irmãos, doze;
verses.en_web: the third to Zaccur, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
verses.en_bbe: The third Zaccur, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.en: The fourth to Izri, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.pt: a quarta a Izri, seus filhos e irmãos, doze;
verses.en_web: the fourth to Izri, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
verses.en_bbe: The fourth Izri, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.pt: a quinta a Netanias, seus filhos e irmaos, doze;
verses.en_web: the fifth to Nethaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
verses.en_bbe: The fifth Nethaniah, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.pt: a sexta a Buquias, seus filhos e irmãos, doze;
verses.en_web: the sixth to Bukkiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
verses.en_bbe: The sixth Bukkiah, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.en_bbe: The seventh Jesharelah, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.en_bbe: The eighth Jeshaiah, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.en_web: the ninth to Mattaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
verses.en_bbe: The ninth Mattaniah, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.en_bbe: The tenth Shimei, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.en_web: the eleventh to Azarel, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
verses.en_bbe: The eleventh Azarel, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.en_web: the twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
verses.en_bbe: The twelfth Hashabiah, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.en: The thirteenth to Shubael, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.pt: a décima terceira a Subael, seus filhos: e irmãos, doze;
verses.en_web: for the thirteenth, Shubael, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
verses.en_bbe: The thirteenth Shubael, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.en_web: for the fourteenth, Mattithiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
verses.en_bbe: The fourteenth Mattithiah, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.en_bbe: The fifteenth Jeremoth, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.en_bbe: The sixteenth Hananiah, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.en_bbe: The nineteenth Mallothi, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.en_bbe: The twentieth Eliathah, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.pt: a vigésima primeira a Hotir, seus filhos e irmãos, doze;
verses.en_web: for the twenty-first to Hothir, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
verses.en_bbe: The twenty-first Hothir, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.pt: a vigésima segunda a Gidálti, seus filhos e irmãos, doze;
verses.en_web: for the twenty-second to Giddalti, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
verses.en_bbe: The twenty-second Giddalti, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.en_bbe: The twenty-third Mahazioth, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;

verses.en_web: for the twenty-fourth to Romamti-Ezer, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
verses.en_bbe: The twenty-fourth Romamti-ezer, with his sons and his brothers, twelve.
